title: Java extract-method/hygiene should preserve helper formatting, indentation, and method spacing
wanted_capability: java.extractMethodCodeBlock or post-apply java.hygiene should produce professionally formatted Java: call-site indentation, blank line between methods, helper signature on its own line, and body indentation preserved or normalized. A compile-only gate is insufficient for generated helper quality.
missing_primitive: extract-method formatting/hygiene normalization for helper insertion and moved block indentation
fallback_used: Probe accepted a compile-valid result but orchestrator diff review caught badly formatted helper insertion and body indentation that hygiene did not repair.
resolution_note: Addressed by preserving call-site indentation, replacing method-separator whitespace during helper insertion, and re-indenting moved blocks relative to the helper body in java.extractMethodCodeBlock.
